comment: The Passwall Node upgrade policy: which releases this panel may offer as an upgrade target, and along which verified paths. revision is a monotonic publication counter: a higher number supersedes a lower one, and a lower one is refused rather than applied. See docs/release-catalog-redesign-plan.md. REVISION 2 DROPS THE LEGACY REGISTRY: the scheme was removed, so the two v0.0.1-beta releases that were listed here are not versions any more, the beta3-to-beta11 path between them is not a path, and the three beta refusals record decisions about names that cannot be requested. Nothing replaces them yet, and an empty list is the honest state rather than a gap: a release becomes an upgrade target by being reviewed, and no product release has been reviewed as one.

applies_to_psp.comment: The PSP versions this revision was reviewed for. A build outside this range must not apply it. This is separate from the FIRST segment of a product version, which is a release line and not a compatibility major.
